title: Appending one record bit
statement: For every Boolean input word $x$, states $q,q'$, valid input-head position $p$, integer source-head position $z$, and Boolean words $w,r$, applying the action that leaves the source tape unchanged while moving its head by $d$, writes the bit $b$ at the record head and moves that head one cell right, emits no output, leaves the input head fixed, and enters state $q'$, yields the configuration with state $q'$, source head at $z+d$, source word $w$, record $r$ followed by $b$, and all other listed configuration data unchanged.
replaced: For every copier configuration and every action that writes a bit $b$ at the record head while moving the source head by $d$, applying the action yields the configuration with exactly $b$ appended to the record and the source head moved by $d$; nothing else changes.
